comparator: Same carry-forward rule with no_reported_cases for missing history.
holdout: All eligible 2026 disease-area rows in published MMWR weeks >=5; week 4 provides lag context only. Use exact adjacent calendar week. Exclude conflicting or unscorable disease-area-week counts.
policy: Carry forward a valid count from exactly the previous week in the same area and disease. When absent use the frozen four-way class-balanced logistic argmax.
primary: Additional true positives and false alarms on naturally missing previous counts; also report four-band macro F1 and exact positive band.
prior_rule: Published count with blank or dash flag; numeric count takes precedence, a dash without a number denotes no reported cases. For both labels and lags exclude unresolved flags and missing counts without a dash.
